familyStyle.medium: Premium smoothly shaded 2D arcade illustration; compact rounded action-toy heroes; no pixel-art look
invariants: Consistent head/body/glove/boot scale across the cast
Short sturdy legs, compact torso, rounded shoulders, large gloves and boots
Readable silhouette at small runtime size
Smooth controlled gradients, clean highlights and crisp antialiased edges
Continuous darker outlines; consistent light and materials across views

ratios.status: approximate art-direction targets, not pixel measurements of flying poses
ratios.rule: Maintain one approved neutral model across all poses; perspective foreshortening is allowed, anatomy drift is not.

lighting.shadows: soft controlled form gradients with defined contact shadows
lighting.highlights: clean small specular highlights on hard shells; broad soft highlights on fabric
lighting.emission: local warm light only for emissive identity features; no ambient halo on empty alpha

linework.outer: continuous near-black/dark local-color contour, strongest at silhouette
linework.inner: thinner clean material and joint separations
linework.edge: crisp antialiased curves, no jagged pixel staircase or blurry fringe
linework.weight: consistent relative to character size across directions

materials.hardShell: rounded polished painted metal/toy shell, smooth gradient and restrained glossy highlight
materials.armor: rounded satin armor with clear panel volume
materials.fabric: soft broad folds, controlled gradients, less glossy than shell
materials.gold: warm gold with small bright bevel highlights
materials.emissive: bright pale core and amber/orange rim, attached to intended feature

palette.classification: approximate artDirection; visually estimated, not exact sampled or mandatory global palette

bomberIdentity.head: spherical black bomb shell; no human face
bomberIdentity.eyes: two sharp inward-slanted amber slit eyes with pale luminous cores
bomberIdentity.wick: short top wick in gold collar, lit yellow/orange flame
bomberIdentity.cape: red flowing cape attached behind shoulders
bomberIdentity.boots: chunky violet boots with warm gold trim
bomberIdentity.emblem: small original gold hexagonal chest emblem
bomberIdentity.rearView: back of bomb head and cape; no front eyes or chest emblem visible through body
bomberIdentity.carry: both arms raised to support renderer-owned carried object; do not bake bomb into character
bomberIdentity.familyBoundary: Bomb head, amber eyes, flame, violet armor, red cape and gold hex emblem belong to Bomber only; do not force these on other characters.

negativeConstraints: No pixelated look, nearest-neighbor staircase or fake upscale of old drawings
No flat-only two/three-value restriction: smooth controlled gradients are approved
No photoreal anatomy, thin limbs, tiny head or proportion drift
No text, labels, watermark, banners, showcase composition or floor shadow
No baked checkerboard, matte background, stray fragments or neighboring-frame pieces
No clipped flame, cape, gloves or boots
No duplicated identical frames presented as newly drawn animation
No unintended extra limbs, eyes or emblems on rear views
No copied franchise marks or costumes

workflow.reference_attachment: required: attach actual approved primary image pixels via supported image editing/reference mechanism; a path or text description alone does not transmit the image
workflow.newCharacters: Use family invariants plus a separate identity record; replace Bomber-specific traits and attach approved new-character concept before animation production.
workflow.production: Draw new high-detail poses matching approved finish; do not upscale old low-detail art and claim regeneration.
workflow.alpha: true transparent RGBA; zero alpha outside intended silhouette/effects, no opaque matte or detached contamination
verification: Parse JSON and verify reference paths
Check PNG dimensions, grid, alpha bounds and per-cell margins
Review front/right/back identity and real pose differences
Verify stable anchors, carry pose and runtime readability
Coordinator validates actual final exported sheets and renderer contract before marking production complete

animationGrid.status: refined production contract; actual final output must be verified by coordinator
animationGrid.indexing: zero-based rows, left-to-right columns; unused cells transparent
animationGrid.views: front/right/back; renderer mirrors right for left

master.lastRow: menu pose inventory only; gameplay export excludes row 18

export.method: crop and downsample EACH master frame independently by 0.5, then assemble runtime atlas
export.reason: avoid neighboring-cell bleed; never resample entire packed sheet
export.quality: detail comes from new drawings, not fake upscaling

menu.anchorRule: consistent registered flight pivot per cell; verify against exporter rather than invent a foot anchor for flying poses
